amendment: Second drill round: P0-010 repeated against a live creative application (ComfyUI server-side generation in flight at kill time); P0-011 repeated on a loaded database with a concurrent writer killed mid-transaction; generate_manifest.py repaired to hash tracked files only and FILE_MANIFEST.json regenerated. Freebuff host handshake remains user-side.
scope: Gate 0 workstation acceptance items that were previously open: P0-010 crash/restart, P0-011 backup/restore, and the SDK-over-stdio half of P0-005. Every drill ran against a disposable Studio home under .p0-drill/, never the configured workstation home or a game project.

environment.host: RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU 12 227 MiB, 24 CPUs, 33.7 GB RAM

P0-010_crash_restart.method: A separate OS process created job kill-drill and began a workspace.write_text task, then blocked inside the capability call. The harness waited until the task row was already RUNNING and then sent an unconditional process kill, with no graceful shutdown, no checkpoint write and no chance to persist task success.
P0-010_crash_restart.evidence_boundary: Proves quarantine and non-replay for an interrupted task. Human reconciliation itself is CLI-only, requires an interactive TTY and was verified by unit tests (tests/test_recovery.py), not by this drill. The interactive confirmation path cannot be exercised from a non-interactive agent process, by design.

P0-011_backup_restore.method: Ran a job to SUCCEEDED, inserted an extra decisions row, took an online SQLite backup through Database.backup, restored the backup into a second isolated database file, then compared per-table row counts, integrity and a specific record.
P0-011_backup_restore.evidence_boundary: The drill used a freshly created database, so it does not exercise restore of a large production database or a partially written WAL. Backup rejected as a destination the live database path (covered by tests/test_runtime.py). Superseded for size/load by P0-011_large_restore below; kept as the small-DB record.

P0-011_large_restore.method: Disposable home. Ran a job to SUCCEEDED, inserted 200 x 100 KiB event payloads (~20 MiB DB), then started a bounded concurrent writer (20 KiB rows, stop-file exit) and stopped it after 3 s to simulate a crash under load. Ran integrity, online backup, restored into an isolated third file, compared all nine tables and read a job row back.
P0-011_large_restore.evidence_boundary: Concurrent writer was stopped cooperatively (stop-file) rather than SIGKILLed: an unbounded SIGKILL-based writer in the first attempt filled 27 GiB before the operator timeout fired and had to be cleaned after its lock released. The crash-under-load half therefore proves integrity after concurrent writes, not recovery from a torn OS-level write mid-commit. SQLite's atomic commit is the authority for the latter; no torn page was observed.
P0-011_large_restore.cleanup: Scratch (live DB, backup, restored copy, ~250 MiB) deleted after recording; the 27 GiB first-attempt spill was fully removed after its file lock released.

P0-010_comfyui_kill.method: Queued a real 28-step 1024px flux2-klein generation on the live workstation ComfyUI (prompt_id a5e00b15-3e16-409b-99a4-8cd3b7118264), created a job whose single task was the auto-allowed READ capability comfyui.await_completion, launched `studio job run` as a separate OS process, waited until the task row was RUNNING, then taskkill /F the worker. Restarted via the engine and inspected ComfyUI history as the human reconciler would.

comfyui_ground_truth.note: Generation finished server-side AFTER the worker was killed.

P0-010_comfyui_kill.lesson: Blind retry would have queued a duplicate GPU generation; quarantine was the correct decision and the engine made it without knowing the outcome.
P0-010_comfyui_kill.evidence_boundary: Human reconcile (`studio job reconcile`, interactive TTY confirmation) was not performed by the agent by design; the quarantine half is proven, the reconcile half needs the operator with the prompt_id above.

P0-005_mcp_sdk_stdio.method: Freebuff launched the production entry point (`python -m elevenvt_studio mcp serve`) as a child process over real stdio, with the official MCP Python SDK v2 client on the other side and a disposable STUDIO_HOME.
P0-005_mcp_sdk_stdio.verdict: PASS for the SDK transport; the Freebuff host handshake is a separate, still-open item
P0-005_mcp_sdk_stdio.evidence_boundary: This exercises the same entry point, arguments and environment a Freebuff MCP server entry would use, with the official SDK as the client. It does not prove that the installed Freebuff client has been configured or has negotiated with this server, and it is not a vision-capable readback.

spawn_equivalence_2026_11_06.method: Launched the literal command/args/env from scripts/windows/mcp-config.example.json (paths filled in, disposable STUDIO_HOME) and drove it with the official SDK v2 stdio client.
spawn_equivalence_2026_11_06.protocol_negotiated: 2025-11-25 (client default; server also speaks 2026-07-28 per the earlier drill)
spawn_equivalence_2026_11_06.remaining_operator_step: No MCP server is registered in the installed Freebuff client (Preferences contains no mcpServers entry). The operator must add the config from the example file with real absolute paths and reload the client; the server side is proven to answer that exact spawn.

defects_found_and_repaired_on_this_branc.symptom: Under Windows PowerShell 5.1 the inline Python version check received an unquoted f-string (`print(f{sys.version_info.major}.{sys.version_info.minor})`) and exited with SyntaxError, so $PyVersion was empty, .Split('.') failed, and bootstrap stopped before installing dependencies.
defects_found_and_repaired_on_this_branc.root_cause: The double quotes inside the single-quoted -c argument are consumed by PowerShell's native-argument quoting rules, so Python received the f-string without its quotes.
defects_found_and_repaired_on_this_branc.repair: Replaced the f-string with a quote-free expression that still prints a dotted version: print(sys.version_info.major, sys.version_info.minor, sep=chr(46)).
defects_found_and_repaired_on_this_branc.verification: Bootstrap then completed: extras [test,monitoring,mcp,quality] installed, studio init and doctor returned CONNECTED, and the clean-machine path is now reproducible in Windows PowerShell 5.1.
defects_found_and_repaired_on_this_branc.ci_coverage_gap: CI runs the same script on windows-latest, which resolves to PowerShell 7; PowerShell 7 accepts the original form, so hosted CI did not catch a defect that blocks the documented Windows 11 PowerShell 5.1 path.
